properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 7 at 12:28PM EDT until August 7 at 1:15PM EDT by NWS State College PA
properties.description:
SVRCTP

The National Weather Service in State College PA has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
North central Juniata County in central Pennsylvania...
Central Perry County in south central Pennsylvania...

* Until 115 PM EDT.

* At 1228 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from Mexico to near Spruce Hill to Colonel Denning State
Park, moving east northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and nickel size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
New Bloomfield, Mcalisterville, Spruce Hill, Mexico, Loysville,
Ickesburg, Walnut, Mifflintown, Port Royal, Thompsontown,
Millerstown, and Mifflin.
properties.instruction:
Stay inside a well built structure and keep away from windows.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with these severe
thunderstorms. Move indoors immediately. Lightning is one of
nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder, you are
close enough to be struck by lightning.

Very heavy rainfall is occurring with these severe thunderstorms, and
may lead to flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.
